Privacy Policy

Last updated December 2026

Peak Events by KRD ("we", "us") respects your privacy. This policy explains what we collect through this website and how we use it.

What we collect

  • Quote requests. When you submit a quote, we receive the details you enter: name, email, phone, event date, venue, guest count, your item list and message.
  • Your quote list. Items you add are saved in your own browser so your list is still there when you return. We can't see it until you send a request.
  • Analytics. We use Plausible Analytics, a privacy-friendly service that does not use cookies or collect personal data, to understand which pages are visited.

How we use it

We use your information only to respond to your inquiry, prepare quotes, and deliver and coordinate your rental. We do not sell or rent your personal information.

Sharing

We share information only with service providers who help us run the website and our business (for example, website hosting and form delivery), and only as needed to provide those services.

Your choices

You can ask us to access, correct or delete the information you've shared by emailing kailee@peakeventsbykrd.com. You can clear your saved quote list at any time by removing the items or clearing your browser data.

Contact

Questions? Email kailee@peakeventsbykrd.com.
